function Obj316364_OnEnter(...)
m_batcave_query_time = GetTime()
m_current_leave_message = 1
end
function Obj316364_OnExit(...)
Enable(316364)

end
function Obj316364_WhileIn(...)
local currTime = GetTime()
if currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 0 and m_current_leave_message == 1 then
    ShowMessage('STR_LEAVE_LEVEL_MESSAGE_1', FACE_NONE, 3000)
    m_current_leave_message = 2
elseif currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 1 and m_current_leave_message == 2 then
    ShowMessage('STR_LEAVE_LEVEL_MESSAGE_2', FACE_NONE, 3000)
    m_current_leave_message = 3
elseif currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 2 and m_current_leave_message == 3 then
    ShowMessage('STR_LEAVE_LEVEL_MESSAGE_3', FACE_NONE, 3000)
    m_current_leave_message = 4
elseif currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 3 and m_current_leave_message == 4 then
    ShowMessage('STR_LEAVE_LEVEL_MESSAGE_4', FACE_NONE, 3000)
    m_current_leave_message = 5
elseif currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 4 and m_current_leave_message == 5 then
    ShowMessage('STR_LEAVE_LEVEL_MESSAGE_5', FACE_NONE, 3000)
    m_current_leave_message = 6
elseif currTime - m_batcave_query_time > 5 and m_current_leave_message == 6 then

    StopSideMissionManager()
    EnableHotSpotManager(false)
    
    --Enable(316368)
    --ShowObject(316368)
    --StartCinematicObject(316368)
    --Wait(5000)

    StartFadeOut(2000)
    Wait(2000)
    if IsQuestEnabled(817) or IsQuestRunning(817) then
        SetQuestCompleted(817)
        RequireLoadLevel('STR_FPS_LEVEL_BATCAVE', 313589)
    else
        RequireLoadLevel('STR_FPS_LEVEL_BATCAVE')
    end
    Disable()
end
end

function Obj405674_OnEnter(...)
vz_pickup_manager_waypoint_group = 405484

if bz_pickup_manager_init then
    ----------delete last array
    --print'DELETED ARRAY'
    --fz_show_array(az_pickup_manager_last_array)
    
    if #az_pickup_manager_last_array ~= 0 then
        for z_t=1, #az_pickup_manager_last_array do
            if az_pickup_manager_last_array[z_t] ~= 0 then
                --ObjectiveRemove(az_pickup_manager_last_array[z_t])
                KillActor(az_pickup_manager_last_array[z_t])
                --print('KILLED', az_pickup_manager_last_array[z_t])
            end
        end
    end
    az_pickup_manager_last_array = {}
    --fz_show_array(az_pickup_manager_last_array)
    ----------current array becomes last array
    --print'LAST ARRAY'
    if #az_pickup_manager_current_array ~= 0 then
        for z_t=1, #az_pickup_manager_current_array do
            fz_insert(az_pickup_manager_last_array, az_pickup_manager_current_array[z_t])
        end
    end
    az_pickup_manager_current_array = {}
    ----------current array is initialized with current trigger waypoints
    az_pickup_manager_temp_array_a = fz_RandomChoice({GetGroupsInGroup(vz_pickup_manager_waypoint_group)})
    az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1 = {GetWaypointsInGroup(az_pickup_manager_temp_array_a)}
    if #az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1 < vz_pickup_manager_spawn_nr then
        repeat
        az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2 = fz_RandomChoice({GetGroupsInGroup(vz_pickup_manager_waypoint_group)})
        until az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2 ~= az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1
        az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2 = {GetWaypointsInGroup(az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2)}
        fz_show_array(az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2)
        fz_insertArrayInArray(az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1, az_pickup_manager_temp_array_2)
    end
    az_pickup_manager_temp_array = fz_RandomChoices(az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1,
    vz_pickup_manager_spawn_nr)
    
    az_pickup_manager_temp_string = {
    'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang',
    'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang',
    'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang', 'PickUp_Batarang',
    'PickUp_EMP_Batarang', 'PickUp_EMP_Batarang',
    'PickUp_Flash_Grenades', 'PickUp_Flash_Grenades',
    'PickUp_Smoke_Grenades', 'PickUp_Smoke_Grenades'}
    
    az_pickup_manager_temp_string_clone = {}
    fz_insertArrayInArray(az_pickup_manager_temp_string_clone, az_pickup_manager_temp_string)
    
    for z_t=1, #az_pickup_manager_temp_array do
        sz_pickup_manager_temp_choice = fz_RandomChoice(az_pickup_manager_temp_string_clone)
        fz_tableRemove(az_pickup_manager_temp_string_clone, sz_pickup_manager_temp_choice)
        --print('SPAWNNNNN : ', sz_pickup_manager_temp_choice)
        vz_pickup_manager_temp_spawn = SpawnObject(sz_pickup_manager_temp_choice,
        az_pickup_manager_temp_array_1[z_t])
        --ObjectiveAdd(vz_pickup_manager_temp_spawn, 'kill')
        fz_insert(az_pickup_manager_current_array, vz_pickup_manager_temp_spawn)
        Wait(150)
    end
end
end
